title: Citigroup 2008 10-K Total Capital
goal: Using SEC EDGAR, open Citigroup Inc.'s annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2008. In that filing, find the line item "Total Capital (Tier 1 and Tier 2)" and report its value for each of these periods: year-end 2008 and year-end 2007. Report numbers exactly as printed (keep the filing's units; use negative numbers for values shown in parentheses). If you cannot find the filing or the line item, set found=false and do not guess.

found.description: false if the filing or the line item could not be found

units.description: units as printed in the filing, e.g. 'in millions'

filing_url.description: URL of the 10-K document the values came from

output.notes: Citigroup Inc.'s 2008 Form 10-K, 'Components of Capital Under Regulatory Guidelines,' row 'Total Capital (Tier 1 and Tier 2),' prints $156,398 for 2008 and $134,121 for 2007. The 2007 column is footnoted 'Reclassified to conform to the current period’s presentation.'
output.units: In millions of dollars at year end
